reviewer_measurement.same_repo_record: TensorFEM docs/lint-gate-determinism.md:16 - `c5168e47` with ruff 0.17.3 = failure (1228 errors)
reviewer_measurement.same_repo_record_2: TensorFEM pyproject.toml:75 - 'ruff 0.17.4 widened the defaults with the I/UP/RUF/C4/PL families'
reviewer_measurement.prediction_of_stated_mechanism: a widened default rule set yields MORE findings, not an empty collection
reviewer_measurement.empty_collection_explained_by_report: stated as a consequence of the widening; the report itself concedes the rule-level detail is inferred

findings.impact: A downstream knowledge extraction that turns 'ruff 0.16 widened the default set from 59 to 413 rules, therefore the fixtures collected nothing' into knowledge would encode a causal claim that (a) is not measured, and (b) runs against the declared repo's own recorded behaviour for the same tool version (1228 errors, not zero). The report's remedy is unaffected - pinning one build and refusing cross-version comparison is robust to the mechanism - but the explanation must not travel as fact.
findings.recommendation: Downgrade §Root cause to 'observed: empty parse under 0.17.3; mechanism unconfirmed', and name the untested alternative (JSON output/parse-key or config-rejection change) next to the rule-set-widening hypothesis.

findings.type: declared repo paths do not resolve in the audit environment
report_quote: `pyproject.toml` - `dev` extra now pins `ruff==0.15.0` (same build as the lint job),
findings.impact: The report's file inventory (a whole-tree ratchet in scripts/lint_gate.py with a docs/lint-baseline.json ledger) does not match the declared repository's live lint toolchain (change-scoped scripts/lint_scope.sh + explicit rule-set pin), and the described fix is not in any visible history. This is NOT evidence of fabrication: the report says the work lives on the unmerged branch agent/m4156, and this audit environment holds main-only snapshots with pruned agent refs. It does mean the six repo-path assets are unverifiable here, which the upstream manifest's reachability string (declared_only_not_resolvable_in_report_store) understates.
findings.recommendation: Until the branch is resolvable, packages 03/05 must treat A08-A12 as WITHHELD (not supported) and keep the quote-level locators as the only binding; register the branch/commit as a provenance handle so resolvability can be retried.

findings.impact: The only handles that could resolve the unmerged fix (branch agent/m4156, head 3910110) have no slot in the inventory, so the asset set can never point at a retrievable commit.
findings.recommendation: Add a repo_ref kind (branch/sha) and register both handles.

findings.type: coverage trade-off in the upstream fix
report_quote: ruff is not the frozen build, instead of failing with
findings.impact: The regression suite goes quiet exactly on the event it guards against (a ruff bump): 4 real-binary end-to-end tests skip instead of failing, so a future genuine breakage on a re-frozen build must be caught by the pin-consistency test alone.
findings.recommendation: Keep the skip, but add one non-skipping assertion that collection is non-empty under any ruff, so 'collected nothing' can never be silent.
